name: BXWF World Championship
epitaph: Announced vacant at the fed's own February 1997 founding, alongside a World Tag Team Championship and an Intercontinental Championship; no reign is recorded anywhere in this collection's own 1997 holdings, and the wing's only surviving show (Thursday Terror) crowned no champion.
notes: The fed's own roster-and-titles bulletin, msg_id UDmYOKIJ55UJ, 5 Feb 1997.
